reference_slide.title: Will we get new hyperscalers?
reference_slide.content: Est. share of NVDA GPUs and share of cloud revenue
reference_slide.key_insight: New cloud providers (CoreWeave, Oracle, etc.) command disproportionately large share of NVIDIA GPUs (30%) relative to their cloud revenue market share (7%)
